question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Consider**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Consider** means to regard or think about something in a particular way. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में एक विशेष तरीके से सोचना या विचार करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *After learning about his experiences, I consider him a wise and insightful person.*
 
 
 
• The use of "**consider**" fits well in the context, as it suggests that when we do not know the people of a country, we are likely to misjudge them and, as a result, consider them entirely alien and different.
 
• So, "**consider**" is the appropriate choice as it is a simple present tense verb that fits seamlessly into the sentence structure, connecting the clauses and conveying the intended meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Had considered**" is the past perfect tense and doesn't align with the present tense used in the rest of the sentence. 
 
• "**Considered**" lacks the appropriate connection with the preceding clause. 
 
• "**To consider**" is an infinitive phrase and doesn't fit well in the structure of the sentence. The sentence requires a verb that can stand alone and convey the idea of actively thinking or perceiving.
